artifacts.synopsis: Mr. Psiaki complained that Covenant Presbyterian Church's Session erred in installing officers elected at a congregational meeting that excluded communicant members under age 18 from voting, in violation of the BCO. The SJC sustained the complaint (15-5), holding that all communicant members have a constitutional right to vote in officer elections regardless of age, and that church bylaws may not override BCO provisions; multiple dissenting opinions argued that BCO 20-3 and 24-3's phrase 'good and regular standing' permits local sessions to establish reasonable minimum voting ages.

artifacts.synopsis: RE Mueller complained that the Redlands Community Church Session reaffirmed a practice of fencing the Lord's Table contrary to BCO 58-4, but the SJC found the Session took no action because the relevant motion failed for lack of a second. The complaint was denied, with a concurring opinion emphasizing that BCO 58-4's fencing requirement remains a constitutional obligation.

artifacts.title: No exceptions permitted in Lord's Supper administration practice

matches.evidence: The CCB advised Great Lakes Presbytery that BCO 58-4 allows no exception of practice in administering the Lord's Supper, and presbyteries should use BCO 34-5 when considering exceptions from candidates.

artifacts.title: Permissible scope of communion practice under BCO 58-4

matches.evidence: The GA denied closed communion (members of the local congregation only) as incompatible with BCO 58-4, affirming open or close communion while requiring baptism as a prerequisite to the Table.
